historicalInfrastructureRuns.note: These runs are retained as historical infrastructure debugging attempts and do not consume the scientific budget.

infrastructureRecovery.purpose: Install ffmpeg explicitly, pass a mandatory smoke test, then run the unchanged bounded pilot if and only if the smoke test passes.

scientificBudget.accountingRule: A scientific run is consumed only if the workflow reaches the forced-alignment comparison step after the smoke test passes.
